en: A black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a crowded street procession in Bruges. Spectators in early 20th‑century dress line both sides of a cobbled street, while costumed riders on horses form a ceremonial parade. Medieval‑style buildings frame the scene. Printed captions in French at the bottom identify the event as the 'Cortège du Pas de l'Arbre d'or 1468' taking place in July 1907 and credit the publisher/photographer.
